approved_payload.content: Taung Daily News reports that Atlholang Theteletsa, 22, was found with multiple stab wounds lying on Kgaka Street in Ipelegeng after 20:00 on Friday 9 October, and that paramedics confirmed he had died at the scene, according to police spokesperson Sgt Kelebogile Morake. A 25-year-old man was caught by members of the Ipelegeng Community Police Forum at a shop in Schweizer-Reneke on Saturday 10 October. He appeared in the Schweizer-Reneke court on 12 October on a murder charge, and the case was postponed to 29 October for a formal bail application. Police say the circumstances are not yet clear. The report is in Setswana; this is a translation. No SAPS statement was found.

OpenStreetMap does not label the township, so that this street is in Ipelegeng rests on the report. Police station not named.
